rules.rule: If a curve has dense, evenly spaced anchors rather than sparse ones placed at curvature changes, it was likely traced automatically.
rules.evidence: Count the anchors on one curve. If they are dense and evenly spaced rather than sparse and placed where the curve turns, it was traced.

rules.rule: If magnifying a long curve reveals ripples in the edge, the anchor count is bloated with small errors.
rules.evidence: Magnify one long curve. Ripple means anchor bloat.

rules.rule: If dropping artwork on a colored background causes holes to fill in or become solid blobs, the holes were created by stacking shapes rather than using a compound path.
rules.evidence: Drop the artwork on a coloured background and see whether every hole is still a hole.
